findings.summary: Every CLI-owned assimilation operation is covered by a failure-then-resume case that asserts completed operations are not replayed.
findings.broken_invariant: Compatibility evaluator facade requires independent review evidence.

findings.summary: Repeated semantic rework uses one persisted cursor, creates ordered CURATOR work orders, replays only the required cycle, and stops before a new cycle when the shared episode, token, or no-progress budget is exhausted.
findings.broken_invariant: Compatibility evaluator facade requires independent review evidence.

findings.summary: The generated CURATOR rework order carries only the typed semantic-result contract and explicit stop rules; it excludes lifecycle, indexing, validation, evaluator, ACR, and finalization commands.
findings.broken_invariant: Compatibility evaluator facade requires independent review evidence.
